decisions.reason: Organic sliced ham fits the firm's stated plan to expand organic lines and costs little to keep as a range extension, so the option stays open despite softer organic demand under 2022 inflation.
Organic Kasseler is a cheap extension of the strategic organic range, and there is no evidence of failure since the website shows nothing after 2019, so keeping it preserves upside.
Organic pepper salami uses existing curing know-how and supports the organic expansion, so with little cost to keep it and its value still unresolved, the firm keeps it.

The exotic teriyaki aspic is a niche deli-counter item in a shrinking aspic segment and is the most likely candidate for range cleanup under 2022 cost pressure, but low carrying cost still slightly favors keeping it.
Fennel salami had a page of its own, which suggests it is a supported product, and it is cheap to keep within the salami line, though as a flavor variant it is exposed to SKU rationalization.
A classic liver pâté with veal sits close to the firm's core pâté range with stable demand and low incremental cost, so there is little reason to give up the option.
